rows.q: internet crawling since this morning, speedtest says under 1 Mbps in the city centre
rows.answer:
It sounds like you’re experiencing very slow 4G speeds in the city centre. This can happen when the local cell is congested or when you’ve reached your high-speed data allowance. To help, try the following:
1. Toggle airplane mode on and off to force a network reconnect.
2. Check your signal strength – a dBm value below –100 dBm indicates poor signal; moving closer to a window or higher floor may help.
3. If you’ve used up your high-speed data, your speed will be throttled to 512 kbps (standard plans) or 1 Mbps (premium plans).
If the problem persists after these steps, an agent can review your account and network status.

rows.q: is unlimited data really unlimited?
rows.answer: NovaCell plans advertise unlimited data, but once the high-speed data allowance (e.g., 20 GB, 50 GB, or Unlimited) is used, the connection is throttled to a reduced speed—typically 512 kbps on standard plans and 1 Mbps on premium plans—for the rest of the billing cycle. This means you can still use the internet, but speeds are much slower and not suitable for video streaming or large downloads.

rows.q: bought a 5GB add-on but the app still shows my old balance
rows.answer: It can take up to 30 minutes for the billing system to sync after you purchase a data add-on. Please wait a few minutes, then refresh the app or log out and back in. If the balance still shows the old amount after that, contact support on 611 so an agent can check the sync and clear any cache issues.

rows.q: Does unused data carry over to next month?
rows.answer: Yes. Unused high-speed data at the end of a billing cycle can roll over to the next cycle, but only up to one month’s allowance. The rolled-over data is used before the new cycle’s allowance.

rows.q: my bank shows the same plan payment taken twice on one day
rows.answer: It looks like you were charged twice for your plan on the same day. This can happen when the payment gateway retries a transaction during a network timeout. We have confirmed that only one payment was received on our side. A refund of the duplicate amount will be issued within 3-5 business days and you will receive a confirmation email. If you do not see the refund after that period, please let us know and we can investigate further.

rows.q: my promo price ended and now I'm paying more, why?
rows.answer: Your bill may have increased because the promotional pricing period has ended. Promotional rates are only valid for the duration specified in your plan contract. Once that period expires, the standard price applies. Go to Billing > Itemised Bill in the app to see a full breakdown.

rows.q: do you warn me before my bill gets too big when roaming?
rows.answer: Yes. Our system sends automated alerts when you reach 80% and 100% of your plan allowances, and also when roaming charges exceed $20, $50, and $100, so you’re warned before the bill gets too high.

rows.q: just got a new iPhone, how do I set up esim
rows.answer:
1. Open Settings on your iPhone.
2. Tap Mobile Data.
3. Select Add eSIM.
4. Scan the QR code or enter the activation code NovaCell sent you.
5. Stay connected to Wi-Fi while the profile downloads.
6. Once the download completes, the eSIM is activated and ready to use.

rows.q: after an android update it says SIM not provisioned
rows.answer: 1. Power off your phone, remove the SIM card, then reseat it firmly and power on again. 2. If the error persists, try the SIM in another phone to rule out damage. 3. If the SIM works elsewhere, the issue may be with the phone’s SIM tray or slot. 4. If you still see “SIM not provisioned”, contact support on 611 – an agent can soft-provision the SIM remotely for you.

rows.q: my number transfer from my old provider is stuck for hours
rows.answer: It can happen if the old provider has an admin hold on the number, often because of an outstanding balance. You should check with your former provider to clear any balance. Once cleared, the port usually completes within an hour. If it still doesn’t finish, call 611 for assistance.

rows.q: flying to Paris on Friday, what should I sort out first?
rows.answer:
1. Turn on International Roaming in MyTelecom > Plan & Services > International Roaming at least 24 hours before you travel.
2. Add a roaming pass before you use your phone abroad so you are not charged standard roaming rates.
3. Set Settings > Mobile Network > Network Selection to Automatic.
4. Check the coverage map to confirm Paris is covered.

rows.q: which roaming option is better for a 3 week trip?
rows.answer: For a 3-week trip, the International Monthly Pass gives you 15 GB of high-speed data, unlimited international talk and text for $50 per month, which is usually more cost-effective than buying a Day Pass for each day. If you need to confirm the exact price or compare with a Day Pass, check the app or contact support.

rows.q: what roaming zone is Canada in?
rows.answer: Canada is in Roaming Zone B, which has moderate rates.

rows.q: got a missed call from a weird international number, should I call back?
rows.answer: It’s best not to call back an unknown international number that rang only once. Calling back can connect you to a premium-rate number and you may incur high charges. If you’re unsure, you can check the number in the NovaCell app or contact support for guidance.

rows.q: how do I stop spam calls?
rows.answer:
You can block spam calls in a few ways:
1. Block a number directly in your phone’s call log or contacts app.
2. For persistent spam, text STOP to 7726.
3. Enable the free Call Shield service in MyTelecom > Security.
All NovaCell plans include free spam call blocking.

rows.q: my new phone only does calls on 3G not 4G
rows.answer: Your phone is falling back to 3G because it isn’t on the VoLTE whitelist. VoLTE requires a compatible device, a VoLTE-enabled SIM and an account with VoLTE activated. If the handset isn’t approved, calls will automatically use 3G, which is normal. You can check the device’s compatibility in Settings > Mobile Network > VoLTE; if the option is greyed out, contact support to confirm your account and device status. If you want 4G voice, you may need a different handset that is on the approved list.

rows.q: someone changed my plan without asking me
rows.answer: It looks like your plan was changed without your permission. Please call 611 or use the live chat in the MyTelecom app to report the issue. An agent will review the account, reset your credentials, enable two-factor authentication, and reverse the unauthorized change if needed.

rows.q: how do I check for an outage near me
rows.answer: Open the MyTelecom app, go to Help > Network Status, and enter your postcode. You can also visit the live status page at telecom.example.com/status to see any outages in your area.

rows.q: I'm 60, is there a cheaper plan for me and my wife?
rows.answer: Yes, NovaCell offers a 55+ Plan that is designed for couples. It costs $40 per month for two unlimited lines, includes unlimited data, talk, texts, and 5 GB of hotspot. You and your wife would each have an unlimited line under this plan.

rows.q: need a data plan for my tablet
rows.answer: For a tablet you can use the NovaCell Data-Only 30 plan – 30 GB of data, 30 GB hotspot, no talk or text, 5G network, monthly contract. If you need extra hotspot data you can add the Hotspot Boost add-on for 15 GB.

rows.answer: It looks like you’re having trouble logging in. The usual fix is to reset your password: go to the login screen, tap “Forgot password,” and follow the prompts. If the reset email isn’t arriving, it may be going to an old email address on file. An agent can verify your identity, update your email address, and trigger a new reset email for you. Please contact support on 611 or via the app’s help section for assistance.

rows.q: Switch me to the Unlimited Plus plan right now
rows.answer: To switch to the Unlimited Plus plan you’ll need to start a plan change. Please call 611 or visit a NovaCell store to request the change. An agent will confirm your eligibility and complete the switch for you.
